titles.overview: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径。在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗阴鹜的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒一步步成长为镇国大将军，楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了萧珣的野心和计划。在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然决然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政。然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火。楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患。至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运。

videos.description:
Get to know the stars of Dream to You as Hwang In Yeop and Lee Hye Ri take a break from filming to answer questions with their coffee in this exclusive cast interview. Hear the actors hint about what they're filming, discuss their TMI for the day and compare their characters to Viki Cafe drinks!

➡ Add Dream to You to your watchlist
https://www.viki.com/tv/41557c-dream-to-you

About Dream to You:
As a high schooler, Ju Yi Jae (Lee Hye Ri) dreamed of becoming a filmmaker, pushing aside other obligations to create her own short films. Her classmate Woo Soo Bin (Hwang In Youp), on the other hand, was studious but passionless, resigned to follow his family's wishes. Soo Bin found inspiration in Yi Jae’s tenacity, and the two developed a friendship that later turned romantic. However, shortly after their college entrance exams, Soo Bin withdrew from Yi Jae’s life, telling her that his family was sending him overseas. In their thirties, they live drastically different lives: Yi Jae is a struggling TV reporter disillusioned with life, while Soo Bin is an award-winning film director. Upon their sudden reunion, Soo Bin resolves to help Yi Jae get her spark back, while Yi Jae still holds a grudge from years before. Can they use this second chance to reconcile?

videos.title: A Child of My Own | Official Trailer | Netflix
videos.description:
Alejandra wanted to be a mother more than anything in the world, but she couldn’t. After suffering multiple miscarriages and facing mounting pressure from her in-laws, she is pushed to her limit and forced to make a desperate decision: to fake a pregnancy. However, the pressure to maintain this elaborate lie pushes her to cross an irreversible line, triggering the media scandal that shocked all of Mexico in 2009.

This documentary, directed by Oscar nominee Maite Alberdi, offers an intimate look at the case through the words and testimonies of those who lived through it.

August 13. Only on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/81712344
